releaseNotes:
• Smart Sleep Detection with nighttime window and non-intrusive activity checking
• Gradual media volume fade-out over custom duration before shutdown
• NightOff Profiles & Presets (Study night, Movie night, Work night)
• Alarm-Safe Mode to protect upcoming morning alarms
• Auto-Restore Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and audio profiles
• Smart Sleep confirmation notification flow with 'I'm awake' and snooze
